scope: Compact visual-observation dependency evidence from one already-exposed V24 saved scene; no new scene, training, control, motion, rendering, or generalization claim.
inference_boundary: Calibrated raw RGB and metric depth plus declared static asset color and geometry only. Estimates were frozen before privileged state was opened for scoring.

plate_method.method: Segment near-white elevated horizontal surfaces, fit calibrated circle centers and visible radii from opposed 1%/99% XY extents, require repeated view agreement, and compare static face-up versus face-down surface heights.

seven_item_dependency_status.reason: Both circular plates retain continuous yaw ambiguity, and the earlier five-item heightmap outputs remain partial observations rather than full rigid poses.

limitations: Thresholds and the method were developed on this same exposed scene.
The white-disk method has not been tested under occlusion, stacking, changed materials, or another scene.
Radius distinguishes these two visible disks here; an overlapping or incomplete component must be refused rather than assigned by privileged proximity.
No camera-driven physical action was attempted or certified.
No complete randomized seven-item camera-driven table has passed.
